messages:
ryan_mktg: planning a 60m "Open House" next Tue. goal: demo latency pipeline + Q&A. need reg page copy, CTA variants, Zoom/RTMP plan, and post-event clip routing. can we capture company size + role?

ops_julia: recommend single zoom meeting with two concurrent live streams (primary -> CDN, backup -> s3 via ffmpeg). enable cloud recording; we'll treat cloud recording as canonical for archive. disable zoom auto captions (we run custom whisper).

kate_events: reg page: test CTAs: 'see a live latency demo' vs 'request a tailored benchmark'. add dropdowns: company size + role. include one consent checkbox for reuse and speaker consent line. map CTA to hubspot list membership.

sam_creative: post-event assets: full mp4 + VTT, plus 2 highlight clips (hero 0-90s, tech 90-420s) and 1:1 social cuts. email flow: immediate thank-you + slides, 24h hero clip, 72h deep-dive to engaged viewers. tracker: watch_pct, clip_clicked, company_size.

notifybot: reminder set: RTMP healthcheck 30m before, speaker reminders 24h and 1h prior.

ops_julia: I'll provision OBS fallback VM and post RTMP keys in #eng-ops 1h before. ffmpeg capture snippet to use: 
```
ffmpeg -i rtmp://ingest/key -c copy -f segment -segment_time 300 s3://events/openhouse/%Y%m%d-%03d.mp4
```

kate_events: volunteers for tech run Wed 10am, please react.
